items.title: How Much RTX Do You Really Get Through 3 ETFs?
items.summary: If you like RTX for its mix of aerospace and defense work, owning only the stock means living with RTX specific risks alone. Simply Wall St flags an unstable dividend track record, and also points to pressure from unpredictable tariff costs. Holding RTX through a fund that also owns other businesses spreads how much those company issues can move your portfolio, and also spreads any future upside from RTX across a wider basket.
